title: Compute the maximal order of Q(sqrt(-127))

source.citation: Barinder S. Banwait and Maarten Derickx, Explicit isogenies of prime degree over number fields, arXiv:2203.06009; tests at isogeny-primes/isogeny-primes commit ef6638ddfd0f2d68c447f31d282b60c9a00c12f1
